answer: Pearl filing bond stops bulk fakes: each identity locks 70, filing one pearl with a tide-stamped size on a cedar board. Each tide, auditors re-measure 1 in 10 pearls against the tide table; a serial filed twice, a size off over 3%, or a missing filing burns the bond. First filing 38, later 38+8(k-1), each extra pearl needs a new cedar slot: 1,000 fakes owe 4,034,000 for 40,000. Rented filings share none. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep it.
